headline: QSR Management Trust files Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code for Sapphire Foods
sum: QSR Management Trust disclosed a substantial acquisition triggering SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), signalling a strategic acquisition or stake build in Sapphire Foods India Limited, a QSR operator.
detail: QSR Management Trust has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange. This disclosure mechanism is triggered when a person or group (including concert parties) acquires shares crossing specified thresholds (typically 5% incremental for listed entities). Sapphire Foods India Limited operates QSR brands including Hari Om Restaurants and other food & beverage franchises. The filing indicates either a fresh substantial acquisition or movement across a regulatory threshold necessitating public disclosure and potential open-offer obligations.
